reviews.text: Terrible experience with financial transparency and budgeting. They give you an initial quote, but as your pet's care progresses, they add hidden and unexpected expenses and order a cascade of unnecessary tests when you're already vulnerable and distressed. They don't honor what was agreed upon. There's a lack of empathy and ethics in their financial management.

They sell you false hope! They don't care about your pet's health! Don't trust them!
I took my dog ​​to physical therapy. At first, they said he was going to be fine and they treated me really well. After 10 sessions, they said who knows if he'd improve since I'd paid upfront.

Do not take your dogs to Dr. Damaris Rosales. I took my dog ​​there for a bee sting, and they wouldn't let me show her where she was stung, only tell me to describe it. When I finally showed her where she "checked" her, it wasn't the actual sting. They also put in a catheter, and while they had always treated her well before, they left her with some very ugly bruises. It's so disappointing to have inexperienced people working there.

I took my cat for a CT scan, and unfortunately, the whole experience was very unpleasant.

We were kept waiting for over an hour in a filthy waiting room (there were literally balls of dog hair on the floor), with large dogs running loose (and no staff member supervising), and a constant, extremely loud noise from floor repairs (which was deafening for everyone present). My cat was very frightened by all of this.

Furthermore, the staff was unsympathetic and even indifferent. When we asked how long it would be before we were seen (even though we had an appointment!), they just said they didn't know.
The examination rooms are uncomfortable for patients. When we expressed our dissatisfaction, the doctor who saw him was initially a bit rude, but later explained everything calmly and in detail.

Once I dropped off my cat, they said they'd take him in for the procedure in 30 minutes. Two hours passed without any news… until I called to ask, and they told me they were just about to start the anesthesia because a machine had malfunctioned.

Aside from the veterinarian who performed the procedure, no one on the staff apologized for any of the problems, and they handed my cat back to me at reception saying, “That's it.” I understand that things can always go wrong, but you pay for quality service, and that wasn't it. And the lack of empathy is what bothered me the most.

My cat had to endure four hours in that place 😞 We will never return to Pedregal.
Excellent place
Always very attentive and professional
It's very frustrating to be in an emergency and have a supposed artificial intelligence answer. I disagree; call one if it's an emergency and disconnect the call.
It was a terrible experience. They treated my dog ​​very badly. I'm never going back. They injured his spine. They don't know how to treat our pets. A big no-no!

Today I want to speak out because I requested information about Sanguinia's death and they are ignoring me. I will be filing complaints daily because it's not fair. I was paying almost 5000 a day and in the end my daughter passed away, and all I want is to know about her illnesses, but they aren't giving me any answers. Today I accuse them of being unsympathetic with their clients.

Excellent veterinarians and facilities. We've been taking our dogs there for over fifteen years. They've provided very professional care, both in general medicine and in specialist procedures and surgeries.
Excellent service and attention, I definitely recommend it 100%.
Highly recommended, affordable prices, good and efficient service. 😉 …
They've always treated my dog ​​very well!

Excellent service! They performed an emergency C-section on my dog ​​and were incredibly attentive, careful, and provided the best care in the middle of the night!

Thank you!!! 🙏

My honest review of this place :)
I know it's not cheap, but since they're specialist consultations, I understand the price (1100 pesos) per consultation.
The parking lot is small, but they have valet parking, which makes getting there easier.
The reception staff was always good every time we went; they were quick and efficient.
Although the wait time between appointments sometimes varied, they always treated my dog ​​and us well.
The veterinarian, Aytzee Piñón, is very good; she operated on my dog's eye, and he's as good as new :)
Thank you for your attention :)

A place where they're mostly just trying to rip you off. I took my cat there, and they were never able to give me a diagnosis. They did order tests here and there, and prescribed all sorts of medications—she even came out drugged. In just a couple of days, the bill came to over 12,000 pesos. They charge you for everything. I decided to take her out voluntarily, and at another vet, they gave me a diagnosis right away with just a blood test.
If you have the chance to take your pets there, don't.
I arrived at 2 am for emergency care for my dog ​​and although I knocked repeatedly, no one answered.
They have good specialists.

The experience was great; I took my dog ​​for a CT scan. They gave me all the information very clearly about the procedure, risks, etc., and they treated my little one very well 😊. Although the scan process takes some time, they kept me informed the whole time 👍 …

I took my dog ​​twice for a checkup on a paw injury, and both times they gave me a misdiagnosis, even after I ordered an x-ray. During the second appointment, they even told me he wasn't in pain anymore and insisted I see an orthopedist, refusing to take responsibility for the misdiagnosis. They wanted me to pay for another orthopedic consultation. My dog ​​has a torn cruciate ligament, and they didn't notice it in those two visits.
Excellent service, the best doctors, and the best care.

They took great care of my little girl; she smells clean, something many veterinary clinics neglect. They're hygienic here. I just want to suggest something I don't think exists anywhere else: a space where you can sleep, even if it's just in a recliner, with your pet, like in a private hospital for humans. A small room or designated area would be ideal so you're not separated. Separation is cruel for pets, who feel abandoned because they don't know what's happening, they don't understand it's a hospital, they just feel left alone with their pain! Even if you charge for the human's stay, pets are family. It's just a suggestion; otherwise, the service was excellent.
Excellent service. I took my pet in for treatment and everything was great.

It's a good place; I liked the attention and service, and it's efficient, especially the receptionist who helped me—he was very friendly and helpful. It was a bit more expensive than I expected, but I don't think it's a bad place, and I want to emphasize that the service was good overall.
Very poor service from the ophthalmologist. I had to find another option. Not worth it.
Excellent service. Very attentive and professional doctors!
Tom and Sam are on vacation in Veracruz. They received excellent care at Vet.Animal Home. Their veterinarians are professional and, above all, very humane and loving with the animals. Xavier Aguilar

We went to the emergency room with Mazapán, a large kitten, but he was very weak and small due to his illness. The doctor's attention was immediate; they took x-rays and ultrasounds, and surgery was necessary to remove a long thread he had ingested that had become entangled in his teeth and even his intestines.

I highly recommend the prompt service and the clear and precise communication with the doctors, so you can easily understand your pet's discomfort. It's like a five-star hospital specializing in animals.

My dog ​​Luna went there for orthopedic surgery, and the entire medical team has worked for months to help her improve every day. The care and professionalism of everyone—doctors, receptionists, cleaning staff, and even the valet—are always excellent. They are all not only professional but also warm and empathetic, both with humans and pets. Our experience: “the best!”
Luna LOVES THEM!!!

Negligence and only interested in money.
They prescribe treatments that don't solve the problem so you'll come back, and they order unnecessary tests. I've taken two cats there that died while hospitalized.
It's the best veterinary hospital in Mexico City! No need to say much more. Their staff is top-notch. Nicco is doing well, thanks to them!

I took my kitten to the night service because she wouldn't stop vomiting. The service was excellent; the doctor was very kind and comforting. She treated her with care and gentleness, recognizing that she's a member of the family, and answered all our questions and concerns. The price seemed reasonable given the emergency and the time (11:00 pm), as I had contacted other veterinarians, but none of them could see me, and they also refused to recommend any medication (which was the right thing to do). My kitten made a full recovery with the treatment she received. It's an excellent service; I highly recommend them!

Excellent service; they treat animals with dignity and love. They explain everything in detail, and they keep you informed throughout the procedure so you know how your pet is doing. They even check on my cat Greñitas's health after the procedure is over.

I highly recommend Animal Home Pedregal. Their service, professionalism, attention, and cleanliness deserve 5 stars. They cared for my dog ​​during the day and at their emergency service at night, and the diagnosis and treatments were excellent!
Very expensive!
Excellent service, always. The attention is very thorough and it's available 24 hours a day. Highly recommended.
They have good emergency service availability

Excellent care; the doctors were very kind and professional. We received great attention. It's a real advantage that they're open 24 hours, as we had an emergency on a Sunday and they saw us right away. The follow-up and treatment were top-notch, from admission to discharge and even after the puppy's recovery.
Good service and studies for a first-timer.
Everyone knows my dog ​​and he's always been very well taken care of, highly recommended!
